hero.caption: The Idarado Mine Trestle is a structure within a former mining operation in the Red Mountain Mining Distract of the San Juan Mountains of Colorado, located between Telluride and Ouray, that extracted lead, copper, zinc, gold and silver.  The mine officially opened in 1939 and officially ceased in 1978.  The Idarado Mine's extensive workings extended beneath the ridge with the west portal near Telluride and the eastern portal south of Ouray, Colorado.  While the Idarado Mine is not on the National Register of Historic Places, its historical significance is through the Lewis Mill listing.
